Transcribe your OBS stream live with [VocalStack](https://vocalstack.com/obs-studio-transcription-plugin/), and see the captions over OBS's preview. Captions never go into your stream or recordings.

### Install

Needs OBS Studio 31 or later.

- **Windows:** close OBS, press Windows + R, type `%ProgramData%\obs-studio\plugins` and press Enter (if it doesn't exist, create the folders `obs-studio\plugins` in `%ProgramData%`). Open the zip and drag its `vocalstack-obs` folder into `plugins`; Windows may ask for administrator permission. Start OBS.
- **macOS:** download `vocalstack-obs-macos.pkg`, open it and follow the installer (signed and notarized by Apple). Restart OBS.
- **Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 and later, x86_64):** download `vocalstack-obs-linux-x86_64.deb` and run `sudo apt install ./vocalstack-obs-linux-x86_64.deb`. Restart OBS.

Then open **Docks → VocalStack** if the dock is not showing, and click **Sign in with VocalStack**.
